blocks.text_bn:
ওলকপি খেতে মজা।
অসুখ হলে ঔষধ খেতে হয়।

ও — ওলকপি, ওড়না, ওজন
ঔ — ঔষধ, ঔষধি, ঔষধালয়

image_slots.scene_description: ও-এর ছবি: একটি ওলকপি (সবজি) — object-only (NCTB p21 composition অনুসরণ), কোনো প্রাণী/মানুষ নেই।
image_slots.compliance_note: object-only slot; single kohlrabi (ওলকপি) with leaves (matches NCTB p21); no living being, no stripe.
image_slots.prompt: A simple children's-textbook illustration of a single kohlrabi vegetable with its green leaves, centred, on a plain white background. Bold clean outlines, soft flat colour, no other objects, no people. High contrast so it stays legible in black-and-white photocopy.

image_slots.scene_description: ঔ-এর ছবি: ঔষধ — object-only: একটি ঔষধের বোতল ও পাতাযুক্ত ট্যাবলেট (NCTB p21 এর মতো), কোনো মানুষ নেই।
image_slots.compliance_note: object-only slot; a medicine bottle and a tablet strip (matches NCTB p21 objects); no living being, no stripe.
image_slots.prompt: A simple children's-textbook illustration of a medicine bottle and a strip of tablets, arranged together, centred, on a plain white background. Bold clean outlines, soft flat colour, no people, no other objects. High contrast so it stays legible in black-and-white photocopy.

image_slots.scene_description: NCTB p21 এর ছোট ছেলে-ছবি (ঔষধ হাতে) reframe: একজন ছাত্র (উমর) শান্তভাবে দাঁড়িয়ে, হাতে ঔষধের চামচ/বোতল — একক ছেলে, পূর্ণ পোশাক+টুপি। কোনো মেয়ে/প্রাপ্তবয়স্ক নেই।
image_slots.compliance_note: NCTB p21 shows a boy in short-sleeve shirt holding medicine (C-02 dress). REFRAMED: single boy উমর from cast ref (C-06), modest full-length dress + cap (C-02), redrawn (C-05); same-gender/solo (C-01 n/a but kept boys-only); stripe lands on plain area clear of face/hands and the medicine; high-contrast line-art for B/W.
image_slots.prompt: A gentle children's-textbook illustration of a single young Muslim schoolboy standing calmly, holding a small medicine bottle and spoon, looking healthy and content. He wears neat modest full-length clothing with a small cap. Plain white background, soft watercolour style, clean bold outlines. No girls, no adults, no other objects. High contrast so it stays legible in black-and-white photocopy.

image_slots.scene_description: বর্ণ-লিখন ট্রেসিং অ্যাসেট — ও ও ঔ, স্ট্রোক-তীরসহ (NCTB মূল)। AI-জেনারেটেড নয়; ভেক্টর অ্যাসেট থেকে অ্যাসেম্বলিতে বসবে।
image_slots.compliance_note: letter-tracing grid for ও and ঔ with stroke-order arrows; vector asset, never AI-generated.

lessons.notes: পাঠ ১৫ বর্ণ-শিখি: ও ঔ (🔒 স্থির). CLOSES the 11-vowel block (পাঠ ১৬ = vowel review, page 22, separate). User: KEEP EVERYTHING + add 3 extras/letter. All NCTB text retained verbatim (ওলকপি খাও / ঔষধ দাও / ওলকপি খেতে মজা / অসুখ হলে ঔষধ খেতে হয়) → action=retain-curated is image/addition-only. আরও শব্দ: ও — ওলকপি, ওড়না, ওজন; ঔ — ঔষধ, ঔষধি, ঔষধালয়. All words oral:true named examples → letter-audit EXEMPT; only decodable content = letters ও/ঔ (b09/b11), NCTB-original → exempt. WORD PROVENANCE (map-first, then dict): map has only ওলকপি(ও)/ঔষধ(ঔ). ও extras: ওড়না (scarf, concrete, picture-able, fits modest-dress world), ওজন (weight, abstract WORD-ONLY, common). ঔ — confirmed vs Bangla Academy dict (baabo.jothartho.com/list/ঔ): ঔষধ is the ONLY concrete/child-appropriate ঔ-initial word in the whole language; entire rest is abstract adjectives (ঔচিত্য/ঔদার্য/ঔপনিবেশিক…) or creed-linked (ঔপনিষদ/ঔপনিষদিক = Upanishad → C-09, avoided). Per Principal, forced 3 from the ঔষধ family: ঔষধি (medicinal herb, mildly picture-able) + ঔষধালয় (pharmacy, abstract WORD-ONLY). Reviewer note: ওজন/ঔষধালয় abstract for age 5-6. Images: ওলকপি + ঔষধ object-only (match NCTB p21); NCTB p21 boy-with-medicine figure reframed → single cast boy উমর, modest full dress+cap (C-02/C-05/C-06); tracing = vector_asset, prompt='' permanently. c_codes C-05/C-02/C-06. Ready to merge in order after পাঠ ১৪. NOTE: page 22 (পাঠ ১৬ স্বরবর্ণ review) is a SEPARATE পাঠ, not built here.
